visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 final portable/source-terrain views including the 1024×640 summary. Individually authored unequal square west towers: shorter plain rectangular north crown, taller arched south belfry, shallow caps/crosses, staged cornices, clocks, arched window balconies and pediments. Central rose has stone spokes. Actual open vaulted porch supports a stone balustraded terrace. Red-tile nave/lower aisle roofs meet three unequal round east apses with blind cornice arcades and recessed lights. Corrected the north aisle step to preserve its adjoining host range, masked overlapping lower walls at apse openings, removed concealed lower east-tower windows, subdivided broad faces for replacement and added distant belfry panels. Raised the east camera out of coarse terrain; exact ground contact remains unverified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 final shared/geographic views. Geographic captures use flat terrain, while portable/medium-fi fixtures retain standard viewer DEM.
